form.title: Before you start
form.intro: Chizzy is for adults only. We check your age before turning on your camera.
form.introReturning: Confirm you are a person to continue.

dob.hint: For example 27 3 1999. We do not store your date of birth, only whether you are 18 or older.

errors.incomplete: Enter your full date of birth.
errors.notPlausible: Enter your real date of birth.

form.tos: I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <guidelines>Community Guidelines</guidelines>, and I have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

notices.dobAgain: Please confirm your date of birth again.
notices.tosChanged: Our Terms have changed. Please review them and accept them again to continue.

errors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid: We could not accept that. Check your date of birth and try again.
errors.unreachable: Cannot reach Chizzy. Check your connection and try again.
errors.turnstile: The security check could not load. Check your connection and try again.
errors.busy: Chizzy is very busy right now. Wait a minute and try again.

helplines.title: If you need to talk to someone or you are not safe:
helplines.unitedStates: United States: call or text 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline). To report online sexual exploitation of a child, use the NCMEC CyberTipline at report.cybertip.org or 1-800-843-5678.
helplines.anywhere: Anywhere: call your local emergency number if you are in danger.

underage.title: Chizzy is for adults only
underage.body: You need to be 18 or older to use Chizzy, so it is locked on this device. This is not something you did wrong.

region.title: Chizzy is not available in your country yet
region.body: We are launching one region at a time. Using a VPN to get around this breaks our Terms.
region.bodyCountry: We are launching one region at a time and cannot open in {{country}} yet. Using a VPN to get around this breaks our Terms.

closed.body: We only match people while our safety team is on duty, so someone is around to handle reports.
closed.autoContinue: This page continues by itself when we open.

paused.title: New sessions are paused
paused.body: Chizzy is not taking new visitors right now. Please try again later.

turnstileFailed.title: We could not confirm you are a person
turnstileFailed.body: The security check did not pass. This can happen with a VPN, an ad blocker or a slow connection. Try again, or switch networks.

loadError.title: Cannot reach Chizzy
loadError.body: Check your connection and try again.
